predecessor: v1 is INVALID_REFERENCE_CONTRACT_NO_QUALIFICATION_SCORE; its outputs and gold remain immutable.
scope: Fresh synthetic extraction qualification only; pilot bank use requires passed semantic review and separate inventory-completeness validation.
pre_call_gold_closure: Each held-out component fact and temporal/causal relation is separately enumerated. Independent alternatives and limitations each have their own gold atom. The v1 omission patterns were explicitly audited before this freeze.
matching_rule: A project reviewer independent of the extractor maps each returned claim one-to-one to each construction-defined atomic meaning after checking exact spans and semantic content. Any valid extra atom absent from gold invalidates the reference rather than counting as model error.
failure_policy: Retain failed calls and failed passes without quality-driven retry or threshold reduction. A reference defect invalidates qualification and requires a fresh held-out suite before further calls.
